lsd.name: LSD
lsd.summary: Extremely potent lysergamide psychedelic (µg doses). 5-HT2A agonist: geometric visuals, associative thought, intense emotion. Set and setting are decisive.

psilocybin.name: Psilocybin (Mushrooms)
psilocybin.summary: Natural tryptamine (mushrooms), prodrug of psilocin. More organic and body-heavy than LSD, shorter (4–6 h).
riskNotes: Species ID is critical: deadly mix-ups exist.
Commencez bas, la puissance varie fortement.

dmt.name: DMT
dmt.summary: Endogenous tryptamine. Smoked: 5–15 min of full immersion. Oral inactive without an MAOI (ayahuasca).

mescaline.name: Mescaline
mescaline.summary: Cactus phenethylamine (peyote, San Pedro). Long 8–12 h journey, warm, visual and somatic. Nausea on the come-up.
riskNotes: Longue durée : prévoyez la journée entière.

2c-b.name: 2C-B
2c-b.summary: Manageable psychedelic phenethylamine. Colourful visuals, present body. Duration 4–8 h. Occasional nausea.
riskNotes: « Tusi »/« tucibi » rose contient rarement du vrai 2C-B : testez.

mdma.name: MDMA
mdma.summary: Reference empathogen: massive serotonin release. Common oral dose 80–120 mg. Do not redose; wait weeks between sessions.
riskNotes: Règle de la sérotonine : espacez d’au moins 6-8 semaines.
Buvez ~500 ml d’eau/heure si vous dansez, sans excès (risque hyponatrémie).

ketamine.name: Ketamine
ketamine.summary: NMDA antagonist, dissociative anaesthetic. Body detachment, K-hole at high dose. Bladder risk with chronic use.
riskNotes: Ne jamais mélanger avec alcool ou opioïdes (dépression respiratoire).
Sit or lie down: fall risk.
Usage régulier : cystite kétaminique, ménagez la fréquence.

nitrous.name: Nitrous oxide
nitrous.summary: N2O ultra-short dissociative (1–2 min). Asphyxia if oxygen is displaced, B12 deficiency with chronic use.
riskNotes: Toujours assis. Jamais avec un masque scellé (asphyxie).
Ne pas inhaler directement la cartouche glacée (brûlure).
Supplémentez en vitamine B12 si usage répété.

cannabis.name: Cannabis
cannabis.summary: THC is a CB1 agonist. Inhaled 1–3 h; oral longer and stronger. Relaxation, sensory change, anxiety at high dose.
riskNotes: Can trigger or worsen psychosis in vulnerable people.
Edibles: delayed effects — do not redose too soon.

alcohol.name: Alcohol
alcohol.summary: Legal GABA depressant. Disinhibition then sedation. Mix with opioids/benzos = respiratory depression.
riskNotes: Ne jamais combiner avec d’autres dépresseurs (arrêt respiratoire).

ghb.name: GHB / GBL
ghb.summary: Depressant with a very narrow margin: a few tenths of a ml separate effect from coma. Never with alcohol.
riskNotes: Dose with a syringe/pipette — NEVER “by the glass”.
Respectez au moins 2-3 h entre deux prises.
Jamais avec de l’alcool : combinaison potentiellement mortelle.

diazepam.name: Diazepam
diazepam.summary: Long-acting benzodiazepine. Anxiolysis and sedation. Dependence, dangerous withdrawal.
riskNotes: Ne jamais associer aux opioïdes ou à l’alcool.
Dangerous withdrawal: do not stop regular use abruptly.

caffeine.name: Caffeine
caffeine.summary: Adenosine antagonist. Alertness, diuresis. Anxiety and insomnia at high dose. Rapid tolerance.
riskNotes: Au-delà de ~400 mg/jour : anxiété et palpitations.

nicotine.name: Nicotine
nicotine.summary: Nicotinic agonist. Peak in minutes, short half-life, very high addiction. Vasoconstriction.
riskNotes: Potentiel de dépendance parmi les plus élevés.
Keep liquids out of children’s reach.

cocaine.name: Cocaine
cocaine.summary: DAT/NET/SERT blocker. Short peak, sharp comedown, compulsive redose. Cardiac risk; cocaethylene with alcohol.
riskNotes: Cocaïne + alcool forme le cocaéthylène, cardiotoxique.
Attention aux surdoses en cas de forte pureté.

amphetamine.name: Amphetamine
amphetamine.summary: Mid-duration stimulant: wakefulness, energy, appetite loss. Tiring comedown. Cardiovascular and insomnia.
riskNotes: Hydratez-vous et mangez malgré la coupe-faim.
Space doses so dopamine can recover.

methamphetamine.name: Methamphetamine
methamphetamine.summary: Very potent, long stimulant with high addiction and neurotoxicity. Insomnia, dental damage, paranoia.

heroin.name: Heroin
heroin.summary: Opioid: euphoria, sedation, respiratory depression. Overdose especially with benzos or alcohol. Naloxone.
riskNotes: Ayez de la naloxone à portée de main.
Fentanyl risk: test, and lower the dose after any break.

tramadol.name: Tramadol
tramadol.summary: Atypical opioid plus serotonin/noradrenaline reuptake. Seizures and serotonin syndrome possible.

dxm.name: DXM
dxm.summary: NMDA dissociative cough suppressant. Plateaus 1–4. CYP2D6 inhibitor. Avoid paracetamol syrups.
riskNotes: Évitez les sirops contenant paracétamol/antihistaminiques (toxiques à ces doses).

alprazolam.name: Alprazolam
alprazolam.summary: Potent, fast benzodiazepine. Rapid dependence. Withdrawal can be fatal — never stop abruptly.
riskNotes: Withdrawal can cause seizures: never stop abruptly.

kratom.name: Kratom
kratom.summary: Mitragyna: stimulating at low dose, opioid at high dose. Opioid-like dependence and withdrawal.
riskNotes: Prudence en association avec d’autres dépresseurs.

salvia.name: Salvia divinorum
salvia.summary: Salvinorin A, a kappa-opioid agonist (not a cannabinoid). Ultra-short when smoked, intense depersonalisation.

4-aco-dmt.name: 4-AcO-DMT
4-aco-dmt.summary: Synthetic ester close to psilocybin. Warm, visual effects, sometimes a cleaner come-up.
riskNotes: Store away from light and moisture.

mda.name: MDA
mda.summary: MDMA cousin, more psychedelic, longer, more neurotoxic. Empathy plus visuals.
riskNotes: Plus neurotoxique que la MDMA : dosez prudemment et espacez.

modafinil.name: Modafinil
modafinil.summary: Eugeroic wakefulness agent. Alertness without marked euphoria. Headache, insomnia, CYP interactions.
riskNotes: Arrêter immédiatement en cas d’éruption cutanée.

poppers.name: Poppers
poppers.summary: Inhaled alkyl nitrites. 1–2 min rush, vasodilation. Never with sildenafil (blood-pressure crash).
riskNotes: Jamais avec des médicaments de l’érection (Viagra/Cialis).

methylphenidate.name: Methylphenidate
methylphenidate.summary: DA/NA reuptake inhibitor used in ADHD. Focus and wakefulness. Anorexia, insomnia.

lsa.name: LSA
lsa.summary: Lysergic acid amides from morning-glory seeds. More bodily and sedating than LSD. Frequent nausea.
